title: D.A. won't charge LAPD officer who shot mentally ill man in family's Koreatown apartment
summary: The Los Angeles County district attorney's office said it would not file charges against the police officer who shot Yong Yang in 2024, killing the 40-year-old man inside his family's apartment as he wielded a knife during a mental health crisis.
